purpose: Final candidate versus NASM defaults on the original sixteen cases; one-block old-BASM baseline is diagnostic only.
approval: Root approved before collecting any N30 final data: three blocks, fifteen measured pairs and three warmup pairs in each block; no post-data threshold changes.
case_order: Original fixed order in every block; incompatible cases remain in the report and are not timed.
pair_order: Alternating NASM/BASM and BASM/NASM; invert the starting order in block two.
wall_statistic: Median of paired NASM wall_ns / BASM wall_ns. Above one favors BASM.
cpu_statistic: Median of paired NASM (user_us + system_us) / BASM (user_us + system_us). Above one favors BASM; zero-denominator samples cannot support a win.
memory_statistic: Compare median native process peak_rss_kib for each tool, per block and pooled within each case. BASM must be no higher than NASM.

original_dispersion_gate.applies: Every block and pooled within the same case; no confidence interval can override failure.

case_win: All correctness and integrity checks pass, every block and pooled meet the original dispersion gate, every block and pooled have wall and total-CPU paired medians above one, and BASM median RSS is no higher than NASM in every block and pooled.
full_goal: Exactly 16/16 cases meet case_win under the complete final three-block default protocol; missing, excluded, unstable or losing cases prevent a full-goal verdict.
aggregation: Report each block and the pooled forty-five measured pairs separately per case. No cross-case mean/geometric mean, hidden exclusions, selective aggregation, adaptive resampling or overwrite/retry to obtain favorable results.
timing: Native CLOCK_MONOTONIC around fork/exec/wait4; includes process startup and output publication. CPU and peak RSS use native wait4.
configuration: Full unsanitized retained BearBasm basm-host, GCC 13 -O2 and software SHA build; NASM 3.02 normal build and default -Ox. No product/compiler flag changes for favorable timing.
object_policy: Unique fixed-width same-length paths on every invocation, all original objects retained, before/after snapshots and final all-artifact revalidation; any drift refuses the result.
disk_reserve: Require 2 GiB free before final collection, 768 MiB before one-block diagnosis, or 192 MiB for validation only; refine estimate from initial outputs before any measured sample.
limits: Shared virtualized host, warm page/filesystem cache, no exclusive core or fixed frequency. Blocks increase observations; they do not guarantee statistical independence. No generated machine code execution and no whole-market performance inference.
